festival.name: WILD SIGNAL
festival.type: Ecology, sound art, and experimental music festival
festival.description: A fictional three-day festival exploring how people listen to landscapes through sound performances, field recordings, workshops, and participatory installations.

stages.name: River Stage
stages.description: An open-air performance area for live sound, ambient music, and experimental sets.
stages.accessibility: Step-free audience area; accessible route to be confirmed in the final fictional site plan.

stages.name: Canopy Lab
stages.description: A quieter indoor space for listening sessions, workshops, and small-scale sound experiments.
stages.accessibility: Ground-floor room; detailed access arrangements to be confirmed in the final fictional site plan.
